title: Apply crew votes operation choices and powers through authoritative transactions
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md, docs/design/SWARM-BRIEF-v0.md, docs/design/RULES-SPEC-v1.md and the listed sourceRefs before editing. The imported Rules Spec v1 is the canonical engine contract; the earlier prototype/T01-T10 interfaces are baseline compatibility, not current gameplay rules. Do not restore approval votes, Repair/Sabotage buttons, Witness or five-node tracks. Preserve original IP and engine independence from Firebase/UI/Node. Edit only ownership; publish APIs only through explicitly owned package entrypoints, preserving baseline exports. Use original synthetic fixtures, scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. Do not commit, push, open PRs, spawn agents, provision/deploy services, access credentials or alter swarm budget. Implement the pure service handler for the approved parseMatchIntentV1 ordinary-player actions: crew-vote for one eligible candidate,operation-choice with the authenticated operator semantic Route/Gate key,power-target and containment-vote. Supply verified actor/trustedNow from service ports,never body overrides,and delegate all legality/outcomes to reduceMatchV1/getLegalActionsV1 and integrated Rules v1 reducers. Host start/request-advance routes are separate A066/A065 and cannot be smuggled through this handler. Commit the accepted canonical action/events,checkpoint,request receipt and publication outbox atomically. Apply exact one-round cooldown/Jam,operator ownership,S2 secrecy,Shift Lead power targets,Safeguard/Audit/Containment,permanent Disconnect/Null victory and terminal-state refusal through the engine; do not reimplement those rules in service code. Concurrent actions versus deadlines serialize to one legal result; operation replies contain no other player choice,diagnostic or alignment. Declared shared engine/protocol barrel exceptions expose only already integrated APIs and preserve previous exports.
acceptance: Each authenticated ordinary intent reaches the same deterministic reducer path used in replay,with the actor/time supplied only by authority.
Other-operator choice,illegal vote/target,stale/post-deadline request,silent spectator action and terminal mutation cannot change state.
Accepted events/checkpoint/receipt/outbox commit together; retries/races never apply board,power,RNG or Disconnect effects twice.
Tests compare against canonical Rules v1 fixtures and inspect replies for sealed-vote/diagnostic/Ghost privacy; shared export changes only publish reviewed APIs.
